digest.component_or_area: Plan-review T10 overlay infrastructure safety criteria
propositions: T10 rubric must partition routine durable-infrastructure checks from transient de-risk experiments via a scope clause while retaining all four existing MAJOR safety classes

T10 must exclude transient lifecycle creation/isolation/teardown from routine scope but preserve destructive-apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, and untrusted-endpoint-auth findings in transient contexts
T10 must operate independently without naming T15 or delegating scope across overlays

Packaged plan-review-T10 eval spec must contain ten balanced cases: five pass (scoped throwaway probes, durable fully specified, private-network scoped-IAM transient, secret-manager transient, sandboxed teardown) and five findings (under-specified durable lifecycle, destructive transient-apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext-secret, untrusted-network transient-service)
Offline contract tests must lock exact scope clause text, exact four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier immediately after scope, and absence of T15 references
